# 亿企工场

Yiqi Workshop is an open-source enterprise application built with Vue 3, TypeScript, Element Plus, Supabase, and an AI SQL assistant.

## Summary

Yiqi Workshop helps developers build real business systems with Supabase as the backend. It is more than a UI-only admin template. It includes authentication, RBAC permissions, menu management, user and role management, data dictionary, file attachments, SQL workbench, AI-generated PostgreSQL, vehicle management, TMS transportation management, and driver-side capabilities.

## Key Features

- Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite frontend.
- Element Plus enterprise admin UI.
- Supabase Auth, Database, Storage, RPC, and Edge Functions integration.
- RBAC permission system with menu-level and button-level access control.
- System management: users, roles, menus, tenants, system parameters.
- Data center: dictionaries, attachments, resources, SQL console.
- AI SQL assistant: generate PostgreSQL from natural language, use schema summaries to reduce hallucinated table and column names, and help fix SQL errors.
- SQL workbench: Monaco editor, PostgreSQL syntax experience, JOIN inference, column completion, SQL formatting, error location, result table viewer.
- Vehicle management system: vehicle archives, entry, edit, audit, detail view, insurance, inspection, maintenance, accidents, mileage, routine inspection, parts, suppliers, expiry reminders.
- TMS transportation management system: customers, customer addresses, customer pricing, carriers, carrier pricing, drivers, cargo, contracts, stations, order creation, order list, waybill management, dispatching, delivery management, in-transit monitoring.
- Reusable admin components: dynamic tables, dynamic forms, dialogs, drawers, data selectors, resource pickers, Excel import/export.
- i18n: Chinese and English language packs.
- Responsive layout, themes, global search, WorkTab navigation.

## Target Users

- Developers building enterprise admin systems with Vue 3 and Supabase.
- Teams building CRM, ERP, TMS, vehicle management, fleet management, or internal tools.
- Developers who want a practical Supabase/PostgreSQL admin template instead of a UI-only template.
- Teams interested in adding AI SQL generation and SQL repair to an internal data console.

## Technology Stack

- Vue 3
- TypeScript
- Vite
- Element Plus
- Pinia
- Vue Router
- Supabase
- PostgreSQL
- Supabase Edge Functions
- Monaco Editor
- ECharts

- SCSS
- Vue I18n

## Recommended Description

Yiqi Workshop is a Vue 3 + Element Plus + Supabase enterprise application with RBAC permissions, SQL workbench, AI SQL assistant, vehicle management, TMS transportation management, and driver-side capabilities.

## Chinese Description

亿企工场是一个基于 Vue 3、TypeScript、Element Plus、Supabase 和 AI SQL 助手的企业级业务平台。项目内置登录认证、RBAC 权限、菜单管理、用户角色、数据字典、附件资源、SQL 工作台、AI 写 SQL、车辆管理系统、TMS 运输管理系统和司机端相关能力，适合快速二次开发企业后台、TMS、车队管理、车辆管理、内部系统和 Supabase/PostgreSQL 应用。
